subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core define a built-in Gateway recovery controller now, and which first slice should be approved?
rationale: The request changes core recovery semantics, config surface, service control, and possibly config/state mutation, so automation cannot safely choose the product and security boundaries.

options.title: Approve a split design
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and approve a narrow first slice with explicit restart-loop, notification, mutation, and upgrade-safety boundaries.

options.title: Scope to external watchdogs
options.body: Leave this to operator scripts, plugins, or docs unless a missing core extension API is identified.

options.title: Defer to concrete bugs
options.body: Keep only narrower crash-loop or startup failure reports open until maintainers are ready to design a core controller.

recommendation.title: Approve a split design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and approve a narrow first slice with explicit restart-loop, notification, mutation, and upgrade-safety boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The current central files and recent gateway/runtime history route most strongly through steipete, with adjacent contributors available for narrower slices.
